mapper.select: WITH due AS ( SELECT id FROM job_outbox WHERE (state='pending' AND available_at<=#{now}) OR (state='publishing' AND locked_until<#{now}) ORDER BY available_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE job_outbox o SET state='publishing', attempts=attempts+1, locked_until=#{leaseUntil}, claim_id=#{claimId} FROM due WHERE o.id=due.id RETURNING o.id,o.job_id,o.attempts,o.claim_id
mapper.update: UPDATE job_outbox SET state='published',published_at=#{timestamp},locked_until=0,error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND state='publishing' AND claim_id=#{claimId}
UPDATE job_outbox SET state='pending',available_at=#{availableAt},locked_until=0,error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE id=#{id} AND state='publishing' AND claim_id=#{claimId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM job_outbox WHERE state IN ('pending','publishing')
